hypothesis: At equal dense expert exposure, the official Light-WAM three-state learned-query direct-action expert over frozen H3 layers 14/27/41 will improve fixed balanced80 normalized and physical action error over the C58 full30 ActionDiT parent without losing language, visual, proprio or gripper response.
single_variable: Replace C58's initialized full30 flow ActionDiT with a fresh byte-pinned Light-WAM three-state direct-regression expert. Frozen online INT8 H3, dense data, action normalization, horizon32 and later evaluation stay fixed.
parent_baseline: C58 is the evaluation parent and current promoted carrier; C71 does not inherit C58 action weights because the head topology and objective differ.

references.title: C58 frozen online INT8 H3 boundary

architecture.field: three state taps and shallow action head
architecture.paper: Use selected intermediate video states for action decoding.
architecture.upstream_code: Wan blocks 8/16/24, learned-query pooling, one residual trunk block.
architecture.local: H3 relative-depth layers 14/27/41, V states, same upstream class.
architecture.rationale: H3 is the requested backbone and exposes K/V rather than Light-WAM adapter hidden states.

data.paper: LeRobot demonstrations paired with video states.
data.upstream_code: Dense action chunks with video inputs.
data.local: C58 v7 episode-uniform train manifest, online H3, no disk K/V input.
data.rationale: Reuses the audited dense data boundary.

action.upstream_code: StateFusionActionExpert emits one action per horizon position.
action.local: Masked MSE on normalized 7D horizon32 chunks.
action.rationale: No diffusion timestep or noisy action is consumed.

objective.upstream_code: Launcher also applies an early-step weighting outside the expert.
objective.local: Full32 uniform weight for the first parent comparison.
objective.rationale: Prefix weighting is held for a later single-variable ablation.

optimization.local: Only one real batch forward/backward, zero optimizer steps and no checkpoint until measured feasibility passes.

evaluation.local: Future fixed balanced80 against C58, then fresh paired LIBERO only after offline gates.
evaluation.rationale: No training loss selects a winner.

evidence: Light-WAM commit and source-file SHA are byte-pinned; immutable snapshot required.
CPU tests cover mapping, direct regression, sensitivity, gradients, anti-alias and strict restore.
C58 online dataset contract reused unchanged.
Masked normalized 7D horizon32 regression is explicit.
No future input and no diffusion target.
No optimizer canary or long-run budget is released.
Trainer and fixed balanced80 adapter do not exist yet.

One real A800 backward produced finite positive gradients in query poolers, layer compressors, fusion trunk, step positions, proprio encoder and output head; report SHA256 dce218d67876bfa758979829f06fe46c07990cf84d40becba5dbfc17168d27d7.
Real registered dense sample libero_spatial_ep000378_s000071 produced finite nonconstant predictions (std 0.29720) and masked MSE 0.485857 with frozen online INT8 H3.
C58 is the fixed comparison parent.

probe_evidence.failed_attempt_boundary: The preceding b29d6c9 launch stopped before model execution because the archive had no .git metadata and cloud git was unavailable; it used zero GPU, wrote no output and was fixed only in the new 88ad6a9 snapshot.

decision.rationale: The real A800 feasibility gate passed at 24.58 GiB peak allocated and 25.26 GiB peak reserved with all intended gradient paths active. This authorizes implementation and audit of a checkpointed trainer and fixed balanced80 evaluator, but not a long GPU run or effect claim.
